name: io.github.Orphograph/orphograph
description: Anchor a file's fingerprint to the Bitcoin chain via Orphograph. The file does not leave the device — only the SHA-256 fingerprint crosses the wire.

environmentVariables.name: ORPHO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key issued from https://orphograph.com/account.html. Without it, anchors are subject to the free-tier rate limit (three anchors per twenty-four hours per IP). With it, the customer's subscription or Pack credits apply.

environmentVariables.name: ORPHO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Orphograph API. Defaults to https://orphograph.com. Override only for testing or self-hosted instances.

tools.name: orphograph_anchor_file
tools.description: Anchor a local file to the Bitcoin chain via Orphograph. The file body never leaves the device; SHA-256 + SHA-512 fingerprints are transmitted, the receipt and Bitcoin commitment are returned.

tools.name: orphograph_verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify an existing Orphograph receipt against the calendars and Bitcoin chain. Returns the anchored hashes, calendar attestation counts, and Bitcoin-commitment time when available.

tools.name: orphograph_list_vault
tools.description: List the signed-in subscriber's anchored receipts. Requires ORPHO_API_KEY in the environment.
